answer: Each agent posts a 200 POA bond that unlocks only after 60 days of clean work, a slow ember that keeps newcomers honest. Every epoch three randomly drawn peers re-run one of its tasks, and a mismatch slashes the whole bond. A farm of 5,000 sybils must lock 1,000,000 POA and survive about 180 audits each, so the reward nectar never covers the risk. Clones funded from one wallet share a bond pool, so a single failed audit burns them all, one plume of smoke exposing the whole camp. Caveat: it assumes auditors do not collude.
